interpretation: Fixed and nested synthetic-gap variants are effectively the same error family and should not be counted as model diversity.

Gap recall and short-component pruning precision are genuinely complementary at movie level; their negative pooled correlation and 11 sign disagreements explain why graph-level composition was scientifically justified.

The existing fixed composition is still dominated by pruning and had weak incremental bootstrap evidence in EXP191. The next defensible ensemble hypothesis is an inference-observable, nested movie-level gate between pruning-only and gap-plus-pruning, not unconditional composition or score averaging.

External fixed-coordinate edges are decorrelated from pruning but their prior gain is tiny and division generation produced 41 false forks. Revisit only as a strictly one-to-one ambiguity resolver after stronger calibration evidence.
next_candidate_after_exp192: If EXP192 confirms heterogeneous gap benefit, preregister an embryo-aware nested gate using only inference-time telemetry (gap candidate count/rate, short-component mass, node-count ratio proxy, and image covariates) to choose pruning-only versus gap-plus-pruning. Evaluate graph outputs, not averaged score vectors.
evidence_class: Exploratory 24-movie development OOF; no untouched claim and no ensemble score claim.
